name: Tailscale
description: Online devices by default, offline checkbox and collapsed filter. Unknown stays unknown; collector failure is not device offline. No machine keys, peer keys, routes or user IDs are exported.
template:
<Stack data-gp="tailscale" gap={4} p={6} style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", background: "transparent", color: "var(--gp-text, #e5edf7)", borderRadius: "16px", fontFamily: "inherit", minHeight: 0 }}>
  <Group justify="space-between"><Stack gap={2}><Title order={3} size="h4" style={{ fontFamily: "inherit" }}>Tailscale</Title></Stack><RefreshButton /></Group>
  {status.devices?.loading ? <Stack><Skeleton height={48} /><Skeleton height={100} /></Stack> : status.devices?.ok === false || status.devices?.error ? <Alert color="red" title="Tailscale unavailable">The collector could not refresh device status. This does not mean your devices are offline. Refresh to retry.</Alert> : <Stack gap="xs">
    <Group gap="xs"><Badge variant="light" color="teal">{(data.devices?.devices ?? []).filter(d => d.online === true).length} online</Badge><Badge variant="light" color="gray">{(data.devices?.devices ?? []).filter(d => d.online === false).length} offline</Badge>{(data.devices?.devices ?? []).some(d => d.online == null) ? <Badge variant="light" color="yellow">{(data.devices?.devices ?? []).filter(d => d.online == null).length} unknown</Badge> : null}</Group>
    <Accordion variant="default" keepMounted defaultValue={null}><Accordion.Item value="filter" style={{ border: 0 }}><Accordion.Control p={0} styles={{ label: { padding: "calc(4px * var(--mantine-scale, 1)) 0", fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: "calc(13px * var(--mantine-scale, 1))" } }}>Filter devices{inputs.search ? " · active" : ""}</Accordion.Control><Accordion.Panel styles={{ content: { padding: "calc(4px * var(--mantine-scale, 1)) 0" } }}><TextInput bind="search" defaultValue="" aria-label="Filter devices" placeholder="Device name…" size="xs" /></Accordion.Panel></Accordion.Item></Accordion>
    <Checkbox bind="showOffline" defaultChecked={false} label="Show offline devices" size="xs" />
    {(data.devices?.devices ?? []).filter(d => d.name.toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()) && (d.online === true || inputs.showOffline === true)).length === 0 ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No matching devices.</Text> : <ScrollArea.Autosize mah={options.listHeight} offsetScrollbars><Box style={{display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, calc(160px * var(--mantine-scale, 1))), 1fr))", gap: "calc(8px * var(--mantine-scale, 1))", alignItems: "start"}}>{(data.devices?.devices ?? []).filter(d => d.name.toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").trim().toLowerCase()) && (d.online === true || inputs.showOffline === true)).sort((a,b) => (a.online === true ? 0 : a.online === false ? 1 : 2) - (b.online === true ? 0 : b.online === false ? 1 : 2) || a.name.localeCompare(b.name)).map(d => <Paper data-gp-entry="device" key={d.id} p={6} radius="md" withBorder><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap" align="flex-start"><Stack gap={2} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Text size="sm" fw={600} style={{ overflowWrap: "anywhere" }}>{d.name}</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{d.os}{d.isSelf ? " · collector" : ""}</Text>{d.online !== true ? <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{d.lastSeen ? "Last seen " + Date.toLocaleString(d.lastSeen, "en-US") : "Last seen unavailable"}</Text> : null}</Stack><Badge size="sm" variant="light" color={d.online === true ? "teal" : d.online === false ? "gray" : "yellow"}>{d.online === true ? "Online" : d.online === false ? "Offline" : "Unknown"}</Badge></Group></Paper>)}</Box></ScrollArea.Autosize>}
    <Group justify="space-between" gap={4}><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">via collector host</Text>
    <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Snapshot {data.devices?.collectedAt ? Date.toLocaleString(data.devices.collectedAt, "en-US") : "unavailable"}</Text></Group>
  </Stack>}
</Stack>
